label: butyric acid fermentation
definition: A fermentation in which anaerobic bacteria convert organic substrates to butyrate as a major reduced end product while conserving energy by substrate-level phosphorylation or ion-gradient generation.
observations: Product-specific fermentation sibling of lactic acid, mixed-acid, ethanol, and propionic acid fermentation; absent from METPO and TraitMech after a butyric acid fermentation duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
